intro: Unrequited Love is an Alliance delivery quest originating in Auberdine on the shores of Darkshore. Hollee asks travelers taking the vessel to Menethil Harbor to deliver a personal note to Tarrel Rockweaver, an excavation classmate for whom she still holds quiet affection.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you're heading out of Auberdine, I could use your help!
My dear friend Tarrel and I were classmates in school. Oh, he was such a quickfire on all things excavation! We got split up after graduation--him to Wetlands, and me to here in Darkshore.
It doesn't matter. If you go to the Wetlands, could you make sure he's alright? And maybe give him this? He's probably near Menethil Harbor. There's a boat straight there.
